description.content: Start recovery profile; set recoveryOrderId to the KB8 order before running.

exec: pm.test("Wallet snapshot request succeeds", () => { pm.expect(err).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); });
if (!err && res.code === 200) res.json().forEach(w => pm.collectionVariables.set("bal_" + w.customerId, w.balance));
const o = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Recovered CANCELLED/COMPENSATED", () => { pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("CANCELLED"); pm.expect(o.sagaStatus).to.eql("COMPENSATED"); });

if (!err && res.code === 200) res.json().forEach(w => pm.test("Balance delta " + w.customerId, () => pm.expect(w.balance).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("bal_" + w.customerId)) + (balanceDelta[w.customerId] || 0))));

const logs = pm.response.json(); pm.test("Three original failures retained", () => pm.expect(logs.filter(l => l.step === "COMPENSATION" && l.result === "FAILED")).to.have.length(3)); pm.test("Recovery completed", () => pm.expect(logs.at(-1).step).to.eql("CANCEL_ORDER"));
pm.test("Wallet snapshot request succeeds", () => { pm.expect(err).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); });
if (!err && res.code === 200) res.json().forEach(w => pm.collectionVariables.set("bal_" + w.customerId, w.balance));

if (!err && res.code === 200) res.json().forEach(w => pm.test("Balance delta " + w.customerId, () => pm.expect(w.balance).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("bal_" + w.customerId)) + (balanceDelta[w.customerId] || 0))));

pm.test("Compensation LIFO", () => pm.expect(logs.filter(l => l.step === "COMPENSATION" && l.result === "SUCCESS").map(l => l.message.split(" - ")[0])).to.eql(["REFUND_PAYMENT", "RELEASE_INVENTORY"]));
const p = pm.response.json().find(p => p.orderId === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("extensionOrderId"))); pm.test("Payment REFUNDED", () => pm.expect(p.status).to.eql("REFUNDED"));

const s = pm.response.json().find(s => s.orderId === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("extensionOrderId"))); pm.test("Shipment CREATED", () => pm.expect(s.status).to.eql("CREATED"));
